facts.fact: NIMC, which the article calls the sole body mandated by the constitution for identity management, issues and runs the NIN system with about 124 million NINs by October 2025.
NIMC says the system integrator engaged for the MOSIP migration will work with its technical team to ensure transfer and capacity building.

systems.system: National Identity Management System (NIMS 2.0 on MOSIP)
